title: A Debt for the Contact
author: A. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Gideon Dunmore, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
